source_interpretations.taste skill: Official tasteskill.dev documentation points to Leonxlnx/taste-skill. Other same-name projects were not silently substituted.
source_interpretations.opendesign: Selected manalkaff/opendesign portable Markdown suite; nexu-io/open-design is a separate desktop/daemon application and was not installed.

adaptations: Compact SKILL.md adapters preserve complete upstream entrypoints as root UPSTREAM-SKILL.md, scope visual-authority selection and obey standing user autonomy.

OpenDesign specialist resources are internal GUIDE.md references, not recursively discoverable SKILL.md files; viewer setup copies pinned local viewer, preview is limited to owned artifact root and loopback with bounded cleanup.
Taste page/app histories and browser profiles default to task-local output; browser discovery requires explicit CHROME_PATH.
Hallmark renderer removes global npm/system-browser fallback and reports missing local dependency instead.

Taste horizontal overflow measurement compares scrollWidth to documentElement.clientWidth to detect mobile innerWidth expansion; dedicated browser regression test covers controls, clipping, long labels and desktop.
evidence_kind: Source install, local script and synthetic browser verification; current automatic host hooks and scheduled/email acceptance not established.
